card.name: Nurse and physician assistant job titles
card.fires_on: The word Assistant, NP or practitioner right after a clinical role such as Physician or Nurse, mainly in author credential lines. It also fires weakly on the end of abbreviations like PICC and CPNP.

modes.label: Clinician titles
modes.description: The closing part of a provider title such as Physician Assistant, Nurse Practitioner or NP-C in a reviewer or author byline.
modes.example: Reviewed by Joanne Hindle, RN, MS,<< NP>>-C, OCN.

modes.label: Other medical abbreviations
modes.description: Weaker firing on the last piece of a catheter term or on a symptom phrase.
modes.example: peripherally inserted central catheter (PIC<<C>>), by slow intravenous infusion
